title: Body weight and eating attitudes influence improvement of depressive symptoms in children and pre-adolescents with eating disorders: a prospective multicenter cohort study.
authors: Suzuki Y, Nagamitsu S, Eshima N, Inoue T, Otani R, Sakuta R, Iguchi T, Ishii R, Uchida S, Okada A, Kitayama S, Koyanagi K, Suzuki Y, Sumi Y, Takamiya S, Fujii C, Fukai Y.
